title: Page 4
content_zh:
“所以你不打算再约她出来一起吃饭了吗？”其实看着她一直替朋友紧张的样子，还满好笑的。
“你不要太难过，有不错的对象，我会介绍给你认识的。”以为他是心里失落，她充满歉意的看着他。
“你不用太在意。”
“都说是朋友了，你就不用跟我客气。”她拍拍他的肩，看向时钟，“我也要下班了。”
“我送你回去吧！”他明知她自己有交通工具，却刻意如此说道。
她走到休息室，将围裙脱掉，拿着包包，“不用了，我是骑机车来的；你不是也工作到很晚吗？还是快点回家休息吧！”
他是在家看电影看到很晚没错。“那你路上小心，到家传个简讯给店长或是给我。”说是这样说，他却完全没打算将私人的手机号码告诉她。
“好。”言待榆听得心里暖洋洋的。
“这些蛋糕你拿回去吃吧！”他讨厌吃甜食，带回去也只是丢掉。
“可以吗？”她的眼睛发亮──这蛋糕超级美味，要不是他太忙，她还真想请他多做几份送给她。
“拿去吧！”
“你果然是个亲切的好人，谢谢你了。”她开心的提着蛋糕向他道别。
他慵懒的看着走远的人儿，这女人果然很好骗啊……
第2章(1)
殷策没想过要再来找言待榆，毕竟她已经没什么利用价值，但当他行经茶馆时，却看见那个热心过头的女人跑了出来，还很热心的向他招呼着——
“你有事要忙吗？没事的话，就进来让我请你喝杯茶，刚煮好的喔！”
殷策看她笑容满面，犹豫了一会儿，才慢吞吞走进店里，“不会妨碍到你的工作吗？”
“今天没什么客人，没关系。”她不在意的挥挥手。“我们好久没见面了，差不多有一个多月了吧？”
“你看起来很累。”他坐定位后，发现她的脸上有着淡淡的黑眼圈，“在餐厅工作太辛苦了吗？”
“还好啦！”事实上是快累翻了——最近餐厅的班别从三小时调成四小时，她回到家都十二点多了，洗完澡后一沾上床就会睡得不省人事。

“要不是为了帮我的忙，你也不会这么辛苦。”他自责的道。
“朋友之间是不用这么客气的，说不定哪天我也会请你帮忙呢！”她笑咪咪道，就怕他因此而良心不安。
不会有那么一天的，殷策轻轻啜饮了一口，心里则是冷冷的想着。
“你是走路来的吗？”言待榆看他点头，又问道：“呆会儿要去哪里？”
“我要去餐厅拿个东西。”顺便探视一下店里的情况。
“我还有十分钟就下班，可以顺便载你过去。”
“不用了，我还要先绕到别的地方去办点事。”看她精神不济，他才不想把宝贵的性命交付在她的手上。
“你比我还忙吧？这样身体怎么吃得消！”不过看他神采奕奕的模样，一点也没有疲倦的样子，真是令她羡慕。
殷策听出她的关心之意，只觉得她是同情心泛滥，耳边又传来几句她要他好好照顾身体的话语，他只是漫不经心的应着。
“我要走了。”杯中的茶饮见底，他也没流下来继续与她长聊的打算，向言待榆道别后，他闲适的散着步，突然听到身后有人叫住他。
他转过头，看见言待榆气喘吁吁的跑来，他看着她低头喘气，“怎么了？”
“这、这是店里刚出炉的水果酥，给你。”以为他走不远，她急忙追了出来，结果方向搞错了，害她多跑了好长一段路。
他眼神难测的看着她红扑扑的脸蛋，“就为了这个？”
“你吃看看那，现烤的，很好吃。”她
“可是……我不饿。”他微笑的婉拒。
“哦……那等你饿了再吃，我该走了。”她笑着招手与他道别。
他瞪着她离去的背影，手上拿着刚烤好的点心——他一点也不喜欢吃甜食，谁要她多事了？
殷策皱着眉，看到路旁的垃圾桶，二话不说的将手上的袋子丢了进去。
一个月后——
“你最好有个非常合理的理由把我找过来。”殷策脸上是一贯的温雅浅笑，内心则是十分的不悦。

“今天是大鱼妹妹工作的最后一天，你得过来送别一下，好歹大鱼妹妹也是因为你才来帮忙的，难道你不该来吗？”
“大鱼妹妹？叫得可真熟。”他知道今天是言待榆在餐厅工作的最后一天，但该给她的工资他可是一天都没少给，他可不觉得自己有哪里对不起她。
“当然啊！我跟她可是培养了不少的革命感情，像是之前有个澳客——”
“我不想听。”殷策打断，看到言待榆从厨房里出来，随即露出微笑。
“我今天才跟店长提到你呢！我好担心你再不来，以后我们就没机会见面了。”言待榆惊讶的笑着。
“这段日子辛苦你了。”他笑看着她，对于店长对他猛翻白眼的举动完全视若无睹，“以后有什么需要，就通知一声，店长和大家都会帮你的。”
先说好，那个大家可是不包括他！
“谢谢，你果然是个大好人。”言待榆感动的想着，可惜打工要告一个段落，以后两人是不会再有交集了。
“是你过奖了。”
“我上次不是说要介绍女性朋友给你认识吗？我有一个在会计事务所上班的朋友，她人很好，正好也缺个伴，你有没有兴趣？”
没兴趣，“好是好，但是……”他一脸的欲言又止。
“但是什么？”
“最近工作比较忙，我没什么时间……不过是你介绍的话……”
“没时间真的没关系，我不是说过了吗？你要会拒绝别人。”言待榆皱眉训道。
“你很好，我不想拒绝你。”
她一怔，立刻严肃道：“我们的友情可不是建立在勉强上，如果你是为了讨好谁而去配合，那我也不会开心的。”
“我知道了。”他认真的看向她，“我是真的忙，目前也没有心思去认识新朋友，谢谢你的热心，但你不用费心替我安排了。”
“这样就对了，我大鱼的朋友都很直接的。”她无芥蒂的笑了，突然像是又想起什么似的，递给他一张纸条。“对了，这是我的手机号码，以后需要帮忙的话，打通电话就行。”
殷策也随手拿了一张便条纸，写下自己的手机号码，“这是我的。”
“啊！不用这么麻烦，还是我直接打给你就好了。”她拿出手机。

“抱歉，我今天没带手机出门，你还是用写的吧！”
“这没什么好道歉的吧！”她失笑道：“你这种好人个性还真是教人不放心呢！”
不放心吗？他的心微微一动，低喃道：“你对我真好。”
“这样就算对你好吗？”她没好气道：“这是做朋友的基本义气。”这些事根本没什么，是他心地太善良才会觉得她好。
“当你的朋友真好。”所以她是完完全全把他给纳入朋友的名下了吗？
“这是你第二次这样说了。”她难为情的笑了笑，“其实你人才好，第一次见面，我那么无礼的对你，结果你都没跟我计较。”要是她遇上这种倒霉事，非把对方给臭骂一顿才行。
门边的风铃清脆的响起，客人上门，言待榆拿起托盘准备送水，“我要忙了，你有事就先走吧！不用陪我了。”他也是个大忙人，有时间要多休息才对。
“嗯。”他淡淡的应了一声。
content_en:
"So you're not going to ask her out for dinner again?" In fact, it was quite funny to see how nervous she was all the time for her friend.
"Don't be too sad. There is a good partner. I will introduce you to him." Thinking that he was feeling disappointed, she looked at him apologetically.
"You don't need to pay too much attention."
"We are already friends, so you don't have to be polite to me." She patted his shoulder and looked at the clock, "I have to get off work too."
"I'll take you back!" He said this deliberately despite knowing that she had her own transportation.
She walked to the lounge, took off her apron, and held her bag, "No, I came here by motorcycle; didn't you work late too? You'd better go home and rest quickly!"
He was watching a movie at home and saw it very late. "Then be careful on the road. When you get home, send a text message to the store manager or to me." He said this, but he had no intention of giving her his personal mobile phone number.
"Okay." Yan Daiyu felt warm in his heart.
"You can take these cakes back and eat them!" He hated sweets, so he just threw them away when he brought them back.
"Is that okay?" Her eyes were bright - this cake was super delicious. If he hadn't been too busy, she would have asked him to make a few more for her.
"Take it!"
"You are indeed a kind and good person, thank you." She happily said goodbye to him while holding the cake.
He lazily looked at the person walking away. This woman was really easy to deceive...
Chapter 2(1)
Yin Ce never thought about looking for Yan Taiyu again, after all, she had no use value anymore, but when he passed by the teahouse, he saw the overly enthusiastic woman running out and greeting him enthusiastically——
"Are you busy with something? If you have nothing to do, come in and let me buy you a cup of tea. It's just been brewed!"
Yin Ce saw her smiling face and hesitated for a while before slowly walking into the store, "Won't it hinder your work?"
"There are no guests today, that's okay." She waved her hand nonchalantly. "We haven't seen each other for a long time, almost a month, right?"
"You look very tired." After he sat down, he noticed that there were faint dark circles on her face, "Is it too hard to work in the restaurant?"
"It's okay!" In fact, she was almost exhausted - the shift in the restaurant was recently adjusted from three hours to four hours. It was already past twelve o'clock when she got home, and she would fall asleep as soon as she got into bed after taking a shower.
"If it weren't for helping me, you wouldn't have worked so hard." He blamed himself.
"There is no need to be so polite between friends. Maybe one day I will ask you for help!" She said with a smile, fearing that he would have uneasy conscience because of this.
There won't be such a day. Yin Ce took a sip and thought coldly in his heart.
"Did you come here on foot?" Yan Daiyu looked at him and nodded, then asked, "Where are you going later?"
"I'm going to the restaurant to get something." I took a look at the store.
"I get off work in ten minutes, so I can take you there by the way."
"No, I have to go somewhere else to do something else first." Seeing that she was in low spirits, he didn't want to put his precious life in her hands.
"You are busier than me, right? How can your body bear such a burden!" But seeing how energetic he looked, he didn't look tired at all, which really made her envious.
Yin Ce could hear her concern and felt that she was overflowing with sympathy. A few more words from her asking him to take good care of his body came to his ears, but he just responded nonchalantly.
"I'm leaving." The tea in the cup was at the bottom, and he had no intention of continuing to chat with her for a long time. After saying goodbye to Yan Daiyu, he took a leisurely walk when he suddenly heard someone calling him from behind.
He turned his head and saw Yan Taiyu running towards him panting. He looked at her lowering her head and gasping, "What's wrong?"
"Here, this is the freshly baked fruit cake in the store, here for you." Thinking that he couldn't get far, she hurriedly chased him out.The wrong direction caused her to run a long way.
He looked at her red face with unpredictable eyes, "Is this just for this?"
"Eat it and look at it. It's freshly baked. It's delicious." She said
"But... I'm not hungry." He declined with a smile.
"Oh... Then wait until you are hungry before eating. It's time for me to go." She smiled and waved to him goodbye.
He stared at her leaving back, holding a freshly baked snack in his hand - he didn't like sweets at all, who wanted her to be troublesome?
Yin Ce frowned and saw the trash can on the side of the road. He threw the bag in his hand without saying a word.
One month later——
"You'd better have a very reasonable reason to find me here." Yin Ce had his usual gentle smile on his face, but he was very unhappy inside.
"Today is Sister Dayu's last day at work. You have to come and say goodbye. After all, Sister Dayu came to help because of you. Shouldn't you come?"
"Sister Big Fish? You sound so familiar." He knew that today was Yan Taiyu's last day working in the restaurant, but he never paid her less than she should have for a day. He didn't feel that he had done anything wrong to her.
"Of course! She and I have developed a lot of revolutionary feelings. For example, there was an Australian guest before—"
"I don't want to hear it." Yin Ce interrupted and smiled when he saw Yan Taiyu coming out of the kitchen.
"I just mentioned you to the store manager today! I'm so worried that if you don't come here, we won't have a chance to meet in the future." Yan Daiyu smiled in surprise.
"Thank you for your hard work these days." He looked at her with a smile, completely turning a blind eye to the store manager rolling his eyes at him. "If you need anything in the future, just let us know and the store manager and everyone else will help you."
Let me first say that everyone does not include him!
"Thank you, you are indeed a good person." Yan Taiyu thought with emotion, but it was a pity that his part-time job had to come to an end, and the two of them would never meet again in the future.
"It's you who deserved the award."
"Didn't I say last time that I would introduce a female friend to you? I have a friend who works in an accounting firm. She is a very nice person, but she happens to be in need of a companion. Are you interested?"
Not interested, "That's good, but..." He hesitated to speak.
"But what?"
"I've been very busy with work recently, and I don't have much time... It's just because of your introduction..."
"It really doesn't matter if you don't have time. Didn't I say that? You must be able to reject others." Yan Taiyu frowned and said.
"You're very nice, I don't want to reject you."
She was startled and immediately said seriously: "Our friendship is not based on force. If you cooperate just to please someone, then I won't be happy either."
"I understand." He looked at her seriously, "I'm really busy, and I don't have the time to meet new friends right now. Thank you for your enthusiasm, but you don't have to bother making arrangements for me."
"That's right. My friends in Big Fish are very direct." She smiled without any grudge, and suddenly seemed to remember something again, and handed him a note. "By the way, this is my mobile phone number. If you need help in the future, just call me."
Yin Ce also took a piece of note paper and wrote down his mobile phone number, "This is mine."
"Ah! No need to go to such trouble, I'd better call you directly." She took out her mobile phone.
"Sorry, I didn't take my cell phone with me today. You should just use it to write!"
"There's nothing to apologize for!" She laughed and said, "A good person like yours is really worrying!"
Not worried? His heart moved slightly and he murmured: "You are so kind to me."
"Is this good for you?" She said angrily: "This is the basic loyalty of being a friend." These things are nothing at all. It is because he is too kind-hearted that he thinks she is good.
"It's great to be your friend." So did she completely include him as a friend?
"This is the second time you've said that.She smiled sheepishly, "Actually, you are very talented. When we first met, I was so rude to you, but you didn't even care about me." "If she encounters such bad luck, she will have to scold the other party.
The wind chimes beside the door rang loudly, and guests came to the door. Yan Daiyu picked up the tray and prepared to deliver water, "I'm going to be busy, if you have anything to do, please leave first!" No need to accompany me. "He is also a busy man, so he should rest more when he has time.
"Hmm. "He responded lightly.
